reason: Gaze alternates between spatially separated points across both horizontal (≈30° range) and vertical (≈20° range) axes, with each new location followed by a relatively long, ≈0.2–0.7 s fixation before the next large jump. The movements span much of the allowed ±15° horizontal and ±9° vertical area and are not constrained to a line (ruling out horizontal saccades and reading) or to the center (ruling out fixations). The pattern of discrete, widely spaced targets with ~1 s dwell time matches the Random Saccades task.
